displayDescription: An ink bloom on cool grey washi, then 一念 brushed stroke by stroke, branching into a connected ink network with a vermilion seal.
styleRenderer: SVG (procedural filled brush outlines, masks, feTurbulence paper/ink-edge filters, radial-gradient ink blooms)
limitations: The glyph strokes are hand-authored centrelines with pressure-width profiles in standard stroke order. They are not traced from a verified calligraphy exemplar or a stroke-order database, since none is available locally.
Ink, dry-brush bristle splits, wet bleed and paper fibres are procedural SVG approximations, not physical ink simulation.
萬物相連, 丙午秋, the seal character and the captions are system Songti/Georgia type, revealed as complete characters. They are annotation type, not brush-written.
Blender was not used, at the user's instruction.
STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes. The refresh demonstrates the source-frame recipe from BACKGROUND_REVIEW: ink-bloom-led glyph construction.

Typography: macOS's built-in Songti is declared through @font-face local() sources (Songti TC, falling back to Songti SC), because it has no downloadable font file. On a renderer without Songti, the CJK annotation type falls back to a generic serif.
